notes.title: Error_Boy.exe Plan
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm Walnut Punch, the developer of Error_Boy.exe.

Error_Boy.exe was scheduled for release in Q1 2024

To participate in the Steam Next Fest in June 2024, the company has decided to postpone its release date to Q3 2024.

The decision was made to improve the quality of the game and to inform more gamers of Error_Boy.exe.

However, for those who are looking forward to the game, we will release a demo in Q1 2024.

I look forward to your kind cooperation.

P.S. Error_Boy.exe is a one-man development game and I am Korean.
